scope.sampling: One fresh Node process per operation; one sample per size and object format.
scope.nativeGitStarts: Git TRACE2 start events including facade initialization, namespace open, operation and close; excludes seeding and GC.
scope.operationProcessOpenCalls: Existing Plumbing wrapper calls after namespace open; not object count and not an assertion about retries.
scope.operationSessionRequests: Existing Plumbing session method calls after namespace open; a batch method can represent several objects.
scope.workerPeakRssBytes: Kernel process-lifetime high-water RSS for the fresh Node worker, including imports/open/operation/close; excludes Git child RSS, parent and fixture builder.
scope.wallMs: Operation only, after namespace open; one sample is not a latency distribution.
scope.limits: Finite fixture, no contention or retries injected, 4096-byte pages; neither an asymptotic proof nor a physical disk quota.
